FFIRONSWORN.CoreTooOld: FastFighting Ironsworn needs a newer FastFighting Core. Update FastFighting.
FFIRONSWORN.NeedsCore: FastFighting Ironsworn needs the FastFighting module. Enable it in Manage Modules.

rulesPreference.Name: Rules preference
rulesPreference.Hint: With more than one ruleset on, Ironsworn, Starforged and Sundered Isles have moves of the same name that play differently (Strike, Clash, Endure Harm, Enter the Fray). Follow character sheets: every character makes the moves of the sheet it's on now (an Ironsworn sheet's, a Starforged sheet's), even where that sheet shows other rulesets' moves too. Prefer a ruleset: where it has a move of the same name (and the world has it on), every character makes that ruleset's version. Moves called differently (End the Fight, Take Decisive Action) always stay the character's own.

deadlyWeapons.Name: Characters fight with deadly weapons
deadlyWeapons.Hint: Ironsworn: a deadly weapon (a sword, an axe, a spear, a bow) inflicts 2 harm, an unarmed attack or a simple weapon 1. On, characters strike for 2 harm (3 on a strong Strike); off, 1. Only Ironsworn's Strike and Clash inflict harm this way; Starforged's mark progress.

loreBoost.Name: Lore-Collector advantage
loreBoost.Hint: How much likelier a Lore-Collector's next attack or Compel (persuading, threatening, deceiving) is to succeed after it Secures an Advantage to size a foe up (on a hit; never without it). 1.25× is a nudge, 2.5× a sure thing more often than not. Default 1.25×: Secure an Advantage's +1 on the next move is worth about that much on an action roll.
